subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Compliance and Regulations
description: Learn Compliance and Regulations in one minute.

hook.text: A startup ignores GDPR. A breach exposes European customer data. The fine: 4% of annual global revenue.

buildup.text: Regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI-DSS mandate specific security controls and testing practices.

discovery.text: Compliance isn't just paperwork. It requires demonstrated security testing, logging, and incident response.

twist.text: Compliance is the floor, not the ceiling. A compliant system can still be insecure in untested areas.

climax.text: Regular security testing satisfies auditors and catches real vulnerabilities. Compliance becomes a byproduct.

punchline.text: Test for security. Compliance follows as a side effect.

quiz.question: What is the relationship between compliance and security?
options: Compliance is the floor, not the ceiling of security
